<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="CE" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Skeleton" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=236" />
<trait label="Undead" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=160" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rusthenge](/Sources.aspx?ID=215) pg. 54

**Perception** +13; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Languages**
[Abyssal](/Languages.aspx?ID=12), [Infernal](/Languages.aspx?ID=19), [Jotun](/Languages.aspx?ID=8), [Thassilonian](/Languages.aspx?ID=52), [Varisian](/Languages.aspx?ID=44)

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +10, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +9, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +11, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +11, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +13, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +10

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +2

**Dex** +4

**Con** +0

**Int** +3

**Wis** +5

**Cha** +3
</row>

**Items**
rusted ([broken](/Conditions.aspx?ID=2)) chain mail

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 20 

**Fort** +8 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +13 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 50
([negative healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=42))

</row>

**Immunities**
[death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38)

**Resistances**
[cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27) 5, [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56) 5, [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72) 5, piercing 5, slashing 5

**Rusting Death** When Theiltemar is destroyed, his bones explode as the necromantic energy holding him together is released. This shreds his rusted chain mail as well, flinging rusty shards of jagged metal in all directions. Adjacent creatures take 2d6 piercing damage (DC 21 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save) and are exposed to [rust creep](/Diseases.aspx?ID=25). As his remains settled to the floor, the [_wall of force_](/Spells.aspx?ID=363) blocking area **F14** flickers and fades.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +12 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 2d6+4 slashing

**Divine Spontaneous Spells** DC 21, attack +13
- **Cantrips (2nd)**
[Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Divine Lance](/Spells.aspx?ID=84), [Prestidigitation](/Spells.aspx?ID=229), [Read Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=246), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280)
- **1st**
[Bane](/Spells.aspx?ID=18), [Command](/Spells.aspx?ID=45), [Fear](/Spells.aspx?ID=110), [Harm](/Spells.aspx?ID=146) (4 slots)
- **2nd**
[Blood Vendetta](/Spells.aspx?ID=675), [Darkness](/Spells.aspx?ID=59), [Harm](/Spells.aspx?ID=146), [Sudden Blight](/Spells.aspx?ID=720) (4 slots)

</column>
